//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Husk Spawn -> Config

Enable Husk Spawn.//: Whether Husk Spawn is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

chanceZombieIsHusk.//: The chance a zombie that has spawned is of the husk variant. min: 0, max: 1

onlySpawnHusksOnSurface.//: When enabled, husks will only spawn on the surface.

dimensionsToSpawnIn.//: Dimensions in which zombies can turn into husks, separated by a comma. Leave empty for every dimension. For example: 'minecraft:overworld,minecraft:the_nether'.

biomesToSpawnIn.//: Biomes in which zombies can turn into husks, separated by a comma. Biome tags work too, starting with a '#'. Leave empty for every biome. For example: 'minecraft:desert,#minecraft:is_badlands'.
